name: Eastern & Oriental Berhad
overview: 2026年，集团业务线未发生重大结构性变化，公告主要涉及股本拆细、股息派发及常规企业活动，未披露具体业务板块的扩张、缩减或合约签订。
overview_en: In 2026, there were no major structural changes to the Group's business lines; announcements mainly related to share subdivision, dividend payment, and routine corporate activities, with no disclosure of specific business segment expansion, reduction, or contract awards.
